metadata.discovered_via: manual-review 2026-09-23: PolicyBench root cause r22 (Part A dividends taxed without the short-term capital loss offset); DOR's release on the St. 2002, c. 186 and c. 364 capital gain and loss changes
metadata.source_note: DOR release dated January 2, 2003, explaining the capital gain and loss changes of St. 2002, c. 186 and St. 2002, c. 364 for tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2002. It lists the order in which Part A short-term capital losses and Part C long-term capital losses apply against Part A capital gains and Part A interest and dividends, citing G.L. c. 62, s. 2(c)(2)(a), 2(c)(2)(b) and 2(c)(4), including the $2,000 aggregate limit against Part A interest and dividends. The release describes the law as of 2002; the retained statute scope is the current text.
metadata.title: TIR 02-21: Capital Gains and Losses: Massachusetts Tax Law Changes
